paite: Ahihleh Juda mi'n hamphat tuamna bang ahia aneih tuan? Zeksum leng bang ahia aphattuamna?
heading: Kalhnate Dawnna
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

paite: Bang lam peuh ah aphatuam hi; Pathian thute akiang ua kepsak a a-om ziak ahi pen.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

paite: Mi khenkhatte'n ginna nei kei mah le uh, bang ahi tuan a eita? Agintaklouhna un Pathian muanhuaina bangmah lou in abawl tuan a hia?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

paite: Bawl tuan lou hial! Pathian midiktak hita hen, michih zuauthei hi uhen: "Nang na thugen in siam na tang thei a, vaihawm a na om in leng na zohtheihna ding in," chih gelh bang in.
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

paite: Himahleh i diktatlouhna in Pathian diktatna a hihlat semleh bang i gen dia? Pathian in mi agawt in, midiktat lou ahi hia? Mihing dan bang in ka gen ahi.
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

paite: Hilou hial! Huchibang hitaleh, Pathian in khovel vai bangchi in ahawm dia?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

paite: Himahleh ka zuauthu gen ziak a Pathian thu dikdan amah hih thupi khop hial a alat sem ngalleh bang achia kei leng mikhial bang a siam louh tansak a om lai ka hia?
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

paite: Bang achia, ahon hek ua, mi khenkhat in gen louhpi hon gensak bang un, "Thil hoih ahong tuntheihna ding in thil gilou i hih ding uh," chi a i gen zawk louh? Huchibang ching mite'n siam louh atan uh adik him ahi.
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

paite: Ahihleh amau sang in i hoihzaw khol ua hia? Hoihzaw lou hial. Judate leh Grikte khelhna sikha a om vek in tuma in leng i ngohta vele;
heading: Mi Tengteng Chinlouhna
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

paite: "Kuamah midiktat himhim a-om kei uh, khat leng a-om kei uh;
english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

paite: kuamah theisiam himhim a-om kei uh, kuamah Pathian zong himhim a-om kei uh.
english: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

paite: Ahilou lam ah apial khinta ua, bangmah phatuam lou in a-om khinta ua, kuamah thil hoih hih himhim a-om kei uh, khat lel leng a-om kei uh,"
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

paite: Agawl uh han kihong ahi a; alei un khemna thu agen uhi. Akamsung uah gulgu a-om hi.
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

paite: Akam uh hamse lohna leh thukha in adim hi.
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

paite: Akhete uh sisan suah ding in akinsuan uhi;
english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

paite: Alampite uah manthatna leh gimthuakna a-om a;
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

paite: khamuanna lampi athei kei ua,
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

paite: amit uah Pathian launa a-om kei, chih gelh bang in.
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

paite: Dan in bangpeuh agen a, dan thuthu a omte kiang a agen ahi chih i thei uhi; kam chiteng adaihsak theihna ding in leh khovel a mi tengteng Pathian vaihawm a a-omtheihna ding un.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

paite: Huchi in "Dan thilhihte ziak in mi kuamah amitmuh in siamtang in a-om kei ding uhi," dan tawn in khelhna theihna ahong om hi.
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

paite: Himahleh tu'n bel dan leh zawlneite na theihsak Pathian dikna dan tel lou in hihlat in a-omta hi.
heading: Ginna Ziak A Diktatna
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

paite: Huai tuh Jesu Khrist gintak ziak a, agingtate tengteng a dia Pathian diktatna ahi. Lamdanna himhim a-om kei.
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

paite: Mi tengteng in thil ahihkhelh ziak ua Pathian thupina atan zoh louh nung un,
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

paite: Khrist Jesu a om tatna ziak in, hehpihna a athawn a siamtansak in a-om uhi.
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

paite: Amah tuh asisan ziak a thuphatawina hi in, ginna a muh ding in Pathian in aluikheta hi. Hiai tuh Pathian dikna latsakna ding ahi, ama'n adohtheihna ziak a nidanglai khelhnate apaikan tak ziak in.
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

paite: Huan amah ngei adik a, chih leh Jesu a ginna neimi siam atangsak chih chetna ding in.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

paite: Na ki-otsakna uh koi a om ahia le? Posiah in a-omta. Bang dan in ahia le? Thilhihna dan in hia? Hilou hial, ginna dan in ahi zaw hi.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

paite: Huchi in dan thilhihte ziak hilou in, ginna in mihingte siamtansak in a-om chi in i sep uhi.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

paite: Pathian, Judate Pathian kia ahi hia? Zentelte Pathian leng ahi sam kei a hia? Hi e, Zentelte Pathian leng ahi.
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

paite: Pathian khat kia ahih ziak in; ama'n zeksumte aginna ziak un, zeksumlouhte aginna ziak un siam atangsak ding hi.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

paite: Huchi ahihleh hiai ginna ziak in dan bangmah lou a bawl i hi uhia? Bawl lou hial! Dan tuh i hihkip zaw uhi.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
